stories.headline: Iran war Day 4: drones hit US embassy in Riyadh, Israel invades southern Lebanon, 787 killed in Iran
key_facts: Two Iranian drones struck US Embassy in Riyadh causing limited fire and minor damage; Saudi defenses intercepted four additional drones targeting the Diplomatic Quarter
US closed embassies in Saudi Arabia and Kuwait; issued shelter-in-place alerts for Riyadh, Jeddah and Dhahran
Israel's 91st Division launched ground incursion into southern Lebanon at 'strategic points' as Hezbollah declared 'open war'
IDF struck Iran's presidential office compound and Supreme National Security Council building in Tehran, described as 'most heavily secured assets in Iran'
Israeli air force struck IRIB state broadcaster headquarters in Tehran in separate overnight operation
Iran's Red Crescent reports at least 787 killed across 153 cities and over 500 locations in more than 1,000 US-Israeli strikes
At least 52 killed and 154 wounded in Lebanon from Israeli strikes on March 3; 30,000 displaced
Five US Gulf allies report drone and missile attacks; IRGC maintains closure of Strait of Hormuz

stories.headline: Senate Democrats force War Powers vote to limit Trump's Iran military operations
key_facts: Senators Kaine, Schumer, and Schiff push for immediate vote on War Powers Resolution requiring congressional authorization for Iran hostilities
Resolution would not prevent US from defending itself or Israel from Iranian attack
Schumer called Trump administration's justification for use of force 'inadequate' and the war a 'war of choice'
Vote expected as soon as Tuesday March 3; Senate expected to quickly return to session
Senator Rand Paul joined as co-sponsor, making it bipartisan
Schumer: 'Iran must never be allowed to attain a nuclear weapon but the American people do not want another endless and costly war'

stories.headline: Ukraine-Russia peace talks scheduled for early March in Abu Dhabi in doubt due to Iran war
key_facts: Third round of US-mediated trilateral talks between Russia and Ukraine expected March 5-8 in Abu Dhabi
Venue now in doubt due to escalating conflict in the region; Turkey and Switzerland named as alternative hosts
Zelensky confirmed talks have not been cancelled despite Iran war disruption
Previous Abu Dhabi round in February produced prisoner swap deal and restored US-Russia military-to-military communication
Core issues remain deadlocked: territorial control of Donbas, NATO troop deployment, and security guarantees
Russia refuses ceasefire and insists on full control of Donetsk; Putin rules out NATO troops on Ukrainian soil

stories.headline: 25% tariffs on Canada/Mexico and 20% on China take effect March 4; retaliatory tariffs announced
key_facts: 25% IEEPA tariffs on Canadian and Mexican imports take effect March 4, with 10% rate on Canadian energy
China tariff rate doubled from 10% to 20% on March 4, stacking on existing duties
Canada retaliated with immediate 25% tariffs on $20B of US imports; additional $86B in tariffs in 21 days
China imposed 10-15% tariffs on US agricultural imports including chicken, pork, soy, and beef
Follows February 20 Supreme Court ruling that IEEPA-based tariffs were unconstitutional
Administration pivoted to Section 122 of Trade Act of 1974 for 10% universal global tariff on Feb 24, covering ~$1.2T in annual imports
S&P 500 fell 1.8% and Nasdaq-100 fell 2.6% on tariff confirmation

Defense Department lost 60,000+ employees; Treasury 30,000+; Agriculture 20,000+
USAID, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, HHS, and Department of Education among most affected agencies
Despite workforce cuts, total government spending has not decreased as Musk promised
Russell Vought removed OMB apportionments database from public access in March; GAO objected
37% of companies surveyed plan to replace roles with AI by end of 2026

stories.headline: Life Biosciences begins enrolling first patients in historic FDA-cleared epigenetic de-aging trial
key_facts: FDA cleared IND application for ER-100, first-ever cellular rejuvenation therapy using epigenetic reprogramming to enter human trials
Phase 1 trial (NCT07290244) enrolling patients with open-angle glaucoma and non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy
Therapy uses three Yamanaka factors (OCT4, SOX2, KLF4) delivered via intravitreal injection to restore older cells to younger state
Cofounded by Harvard genetics professor David Sinclair; results expected by end of 2026 or early 2027
Longevity-focused startups attracted $8.5B in venture capital in 2024, more than doubling from previous year
Company also developing similar treatment for liver disease using same partial epigenetic reprogramming platform

sources.title: Life Biosciences Announces FDA Clearance of IND Application for ER-100 in Optic Neuropathies

stories.headline: FDA delays Eli Lilly oral obesity pill orforglipron decision to April 10 as weight-loss drug race heats up
key_facts: FDA pushed target action date for orforglipron to April 10, a two-week delay from original March 28 date
Orforglipron is first oral small molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist to complete Phase 3 trial for obesity
Phase 3 results showed average 22.9 lbs weight loss; taken daily without food or water restrictions
Received FDA Commissioner's National Priority Review Voucher, cutting review time from 10-12 months to 1-2 months
Competes with Novo Nordisk's already-approved oral Wegovy pill ($149/month, launched January 2026)
Eli Lilly stockpiling orforglipron in anticipation of approval for immediate launch

stories.headline: First baby treated with personalized CRISPR gene therapy at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia
key_facts: Baby named KJ became first person to receive a customized CRISPR gene editing treatment
Treated for severe carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1) deficiency, a rare metabolic disease
Therapy delivered via lipid nanoparticles to the liver to correct faulty enzyme within six months
Developed by team at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia and Penn Medicine
Separately, Cleveland Clinic Phase 1 trial showed one-time CRISPR infusion safely reduced LDL cholesterol and triglycerides within two weeks
CRISPR Therapeutics planning regulatory submissions for CASGEVY in children aged 5-11 with sickle cell disease in first half of 2026
